name: Mattaniah
overview: Mattaniah was a male Levite known for his role as a gatekeeper and a descendant of Mica. He was a leader in initiating thanksgiving during prayer, highlighting his spiritual leadership within the Levitical community. His service is documented in the books of Nehemiah.
namesAndTitles: The name Mattaniah means 'gift of YHWH,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's gift. This proper name, as recorded in Nehemiah 11:17, does not indicate it was given directly by God but carries significant spiritual meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Mattaniah as a descendant of Mica, establishing his lineage within the tribe of Levi. Beyond this, no additional family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Mattaniah's significance lies in his dual role as a gatekeeper and a spiritual leader who began thanksgiving at prayer. His position as a descendant of Mica situates him within the Levitical tradition, entrusted with both physical and spiritual responsibilities in the post-exilic community. These roles underscore the importance of faithful service and worship in the restoration period documented in Nehemiah.
